preservedReleases.body:
Native Windows and Linux builds from `8f25193fa09ec7672c197a80c4679eb0d4d5df44`, matching immutable tag `v0.1.2`.

Includes the .NET runtime, the integrated FocusOn icon, recoverable tray behavior, and English / Simplified Chinese with a saved language preference. Archives include MIT and third-party notices; adjacent SHA256 files verify downloads.

Timeline hints follow the pointer and refresh without hover delays. Scrolling to the log end follows appended records; scrolling up or selecting history pauses following. Small separators mark contiguous different-app boundaries without changing recorded times or durations.

Validation: native standard GitHub-hosted x64/ARM64 runners, SQLite and UI regressions, native desktop residency/timer/exit checks, and file/archive/architecture/runtime verification. Linux includes isolated X11 capture and StatusNotifier registration/host-loss checks. Real desktop power, GNOME Wayland and foreground privacy permission acceptance remains pending.

macOS bundles are attached only after Developer ID signing, hardened runtime, Apple notarization, stapling and Gatekeeper verification succeed on native Intel / Apple Silicon runners. Missing credentials exclude Mac attachments. Even signed Mac bundles remain pending physical desktop and Accessibility permission acceptance. This release stays a draft.

The existing v0.1.0 tag and all Windows/Linux attachments are preserved; their historical source difference remains documented there.

Includes the FocusOn executable/window/tray icons, close-to-tray with restore and explicit Exit, recoverable Linux tray fallback, English / Simplified Chinese with a saved language preference, and the .NET runtime. Existing local records remain compatible. Archives retain MIT and third-party notices; adjacent SHA256 files verify downloads.

Validation: six standard native GitHub-hosted targets passed 102 regressions each, native desktop lifecycle checks, and self-contained file/archive/architecture/runtime verification. Mac native foreground recording and actual .app startup / Quit passed. Linux checks include X11 capture and isolated StatusNotifier registration / host loss. Physical power, DPI, desktop tray panels and permission acceptance remain pending.

macOS is not included in this release. Apple credentials are not configured; Mac outputs are ad-hoc validation artifacts, not Developer ID-signed or notarized distributions. Signing, hardened runtime, notarization, stapling and Gatekeeper verification are configured but have not completed. See the repository's docs/macos.md for secure Secrets and permission setup.

preservedReleases.name: FocusOn v0.1.0
preservedReleases.body:
FocusOn 首个 Windows x64 自包含发布包。

### 功能

- 记录激活窗口的软件、标题和前台使用时长，按日期回看软件汇总、时间线和日志。
- 支持记录范围 / 24h 时间线、当前日期搜索及独立标题计时。
- 支持托盘驻留、登录自启、暂停/继续和按天删除。
- 数据保存在当前用户本机，不依赖在线服务。

### 下载与运行

下载附件 `FocusOn-win-x64.zip`，完整解压到固定目录，再运行 `FocusOn.exe`。包内包含 .NET 和 Windows 桌面运行时，无需另装 SDK。首次普通启动会配置当前用户登录自启；关闭窗口后仍在托盘运行，请从托盘退出程序。

升级前先从旧版托盘退出，再启动新版。默认数据目录为 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\FocusOn`，详细操作见包内 `使用说明.md`。

附件 `FocusOn-win-x64.zip.sha256` 提供校验值。GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 附件是源码；运行软件请下载上述程序 ZIP。

### 验证范围

Windows GitHub Actions 已执行 Release 构建、79 项自动化测试及独立文件、ZIP、SHA256、运行时和 AMD64 架构校验。真实锁屏/睡眠、登录自启、DPI、高对比度与断网运行等设备验收仍按仓库人工清单进行。

构建源：`43d6dfd901d708ce27d13fcfb691e3061f66c405`。

<!-- focuson-linux -->
## Linux packages

- **x64:** `FocusOn-linux-x64.tar.gz`
- **ARM64:** `FocusOn-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
- Each archive includes the .NET runtime, a file manifest, platform instructions, and the GNOME Wayland extension. The adjacent `.sha256` file verifies the archive.
- Extract the complete folder and run `./FocusOn` in a graphical desktop session. X11 capture requires logind; GNOME Wayland requires enabling the bundled extension. Other Wayland desktops support history and title timers, but foreground capture is unavailable.
- English and Simplified Chinese can be selected in the top row. The language preference is saved locally; user titles and historical data remain unchanged.

**Source:** Linux assets were built from [409cb51ed57f79637cfbca6691480aa5bb6a3a69](https://github.com/Liuzkai/FocusOn/tree/409cb51ed57f79637cfbca6691480aa5bb6a3a69), the cross-platform implementation. The existing Windows `v0.1.0` tag and Windows assets are unchanged; GitHub's tag source archives therefore refer to the older Windows source. The Linux source commit is also recorded in each `manifest.json`.

**Validation:** core/platform and headless UI regressions, native virtual X11 capture and cross-process activation, and independent archive/file/SHA256/ELF/permission/runtime checks. ARM64 is cross-compiled; real ARM64 startup, GNOME Wayland, logind lock/sleep/display behavior, and hardware acceptance remain unverified.
